warranty.description: BURHAN STORE provides a 6-month store replacement warranty covering eligible internal hardware and functional component defects from the date of purchase.
terms: Covers internal manufacturing and functional defects (e.g. driver failure, internal charging failure, Bluetooth module defect).
Does NOT cover external physical damage, cracked casing, dropped units, liquid/water ingress, burns, normal battery wear over time, or unauthorized tampering.
Product must be inspected and serial/order verified by BURHAN STORE customer service before replacement dispatch.
All warranty claims require proof of purchase (Order Number / Phone Number).

faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery available for BURHAN Pro 2?
faqs.answer: Yes! Cash on Delivery is available across 150+ cities in Pakistan. You only pay when the parcel arrives at your doorstep.

faqs.question: How long does the battery last on a single charge?
faqs.answer: BURHAN Pro 2 delivers up to 8 hours of continuous listening on a single charge, and up to 36 hours total with the compact wireless charging case.

faqs.question: Does it have low-latency gaming mode for PUBG and COD?
faqs.answer: Yes, it features a dedicated low-latency gaming mode that helps ensure audio and visuals stay responsive and synchronized for mobile gaming.

faqs.question: How does the 6-Month Replacement Warranty work?
faqs.answer: Our 6-Month Replacement Warranty covers eligible internal product faults. If an internal fault occurs within 6 months, contact us on WhatsApp for rapid verification and replacement. (Physical and liquid damages are excluded; Terms apply).

faqs.question: Can I open and inspect the parcel before paying?
faqs.answer: Yes, open parcel verification is permitted so you can confirm the contents before paying cash.
